title: Product Engineer, Backend Systems
descriptionHtml:
The Role

Linear is building the software that high-performing product teams use to build software.

We are looking for a Backend Systems Engineer to scale our real-time synchronization engine and GraphQL API services.

Responsibilities

  • Scale real-time WebSocket sync engine supporting 100k+ concurrent users.
  • Optimize PostgreSQL database queries, connection pooling, and schema migrations.
  • Ensure sub-50ms API response times across global edge locations.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience with TypeScript, Node.js, or Go in production environments.
  • Solid understanding of relational database indices, locking, and distributed caching with Redis.
